alignment.description: Align the module to the left, right or center.
alignment.label: Row Alignment

maxWidth.description: Setting a maximum width will prevent your element from ever surpassing the defined width value. Maximum width can be used in combination with the standard width setting. Maximum width supersedes the normal width value.
maxWidth.label: Inner Max Width

width.description: By default, elements will extend the full width of their parent element. If you would like to set a custom static width, you can do so using this option.
width.label: Inner Width

item.description: Here you can select whether or not your section has an inner shadow. This can look great when you have colored backgrounds or background images.
item.label: Show Inner Shadow

module.description: Top-level horizontal band that spans the full width of a page and holds rows of content.
module.name: divi/section
module.title: Section
